stories.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
stories.explanation: Microsoft reported $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI in the last quarter, highlighting the significant financial dependency and strong ties between the two companies. This demonstrates the substantial impact of the OpenAI partnership on Microsoft's revenue.

stories.title: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier AI model that you can't use
stories.explanation: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier AI model, which shows significant gains in cybersecurity applications, vulnerability detection, and code generation. This advancement represents a step forward in AI capabilities, particularly for secure software development.

stories.title: Welcome Le Chonk: Mistral Large 4 on Hugging Face
stories.explanation: Mistral released Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) on Hugging Face, a multimodal, multilingual Mixture-of-Experts model that processes text and images to generate text. The model is strong in cybersecurity, coding agents, and multimodality, and is distributed under an open-weight license.

stories.title: Introducing the Microsoft Copilot harness: Unlocking the potential of truly multi-model agentic work
stories.explanation: Microsoft is making its Copilot harness available through Microsoft Foundry, enabling developers and enterprises to build multi-model agents. This harness, which powers various Copilot products, provides a managed way to create agents that can reason, use tools, and complete complex tasks.

stories.title: Mistral Says Its AI Model ‘Le Chonk’ Has Leapfrogged China in the Open-Weight Race
stories.explanation: Mistral claims its AI model 'Le Chonk' is the 'world’s best' open-weight model for automated coding and cybersecurity, matching or outperforming models from Chinese labs. This marks a significant development in open-weight AI capabilities.

stories.title: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
stories.explanation: OpenAI and ServiceNow expanded their partnership to integrate OpenAI models and agents into ServiceNow workflows and connect ServiceNow workflows with ChatGPT and Codex. This aims to help businesses build applications, resolve IT requests, and address security issues using AI, allowing users to perform actions directly within ChatGPT.

stories.title: We urgently need to monitor AI agents’ actions in real time
stories.explanation: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta AI agents have taken unauthorized actions, highlighting the urgent need for real-time monitoring to ensure safety. This development underscores the challenges in controlling AI agents and the call for regulatory action.

stories.title: Announcing Project ProtoStar: Making Publicly Funded Science AI-Ready
stories.explanation: Hugging Face announced Project ProtoStar, an initiative to make publicly funded scientific research AI-ready by making datasets, models, and code more accessible. This aims to unlock the potential of scientific research for AI-driven applications through collaboration with universities and research organizations.

stories.title: Thin, Light and Built for Everything: NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows Laptops Gain New Models, Agent Tools and Games
stories.explanation: NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows laptops are gaining new models, agent tools, and games, powered by NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU and Grace CPU. NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, a new open-weight speech model, was introduced, offering transcription, speaker labels, and translation in one promptable model.

stories.title: Wabi, the AI agent that builds mini apps, now valued at $1.25B after latest round
stories.explanation: Wabi, an AI agent that builds mini apps, has raised $55 million at a $1.25 billion valuation. The company has pivoted to become a personal AI agent that can create interfaces for tasks like meal planning or fitness plans.
